## About
Phoenix Auto Detailing is a car detailing shop on Florence Street in Aurora, working on cars, trucks and SUVs across Aurora and Denver. We clean and protect the interior, the exterior and the engine bay.
The shop is run by owner Jesus Osorio, who has a real passion for cars and car detailing. Your time matters, so you can choose service in the shop or out. Our mobile team can come to you at work, the gym or home.
We believe every car, no matter its age, can obtain new life. Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 668 Google reviews. Se habla español.

## Services
- Express Wash: Exterior hand wash and hand dry, wheel cleaning and tire dressing, door jambs, interior and cargo area vacuum, dashboard, air vents and windows inside and out. ($79.99)
- Full Interior: Seats, carpet and cargo area vacuumed, hot water extraction of seats, carpets and floor mats, and cloth and leather cleaned and conditioned. Trucks, large SUVs and vans may cost more depending on condition. (Starting at $179.99)
- Eco Full interior: A complete full interior done with our super-heated steam machine, with no chemicals added. (starting at $249.99)
- Express Wash Deluxe: The full interior and the Express Wash together in one visit.
- Paint Correction: Restores your paint to a deep, glossy, near-perfect finish, close to how it looked brand new.
- Ceramic Coating: Long-term paint protection that bonds to the surface and shields paint from UV, harsh weather and dirt. Paint correction is required first.
- Paint protection film (PPF): A virtually invisible urethane film that protects paint from rock chips, scratches, road debris and bug splatter while keeping the factory finish.
- Window Tint: Tint for comfort, appearance and protection, with a sleek look you can feel every time you drive.

## FAQ
Q: Can you detail my car at home or at work?
A: Yes. Our mobile service can come to you at work, the gym or home. You can also choose to have it done in the shop.

Q: Does mobile service cost extra?
A: Yes, mobile car detailing services add $50. Rough conditions may be subject to additional charges.

Q: Do trucks, SUVs and vans cost more for a full interior?
A: They can. Trucks, large SUVs and vans may have additional charges depending on the condition of the vehicle.

Q: Do I need paint correction before ceramic coating?
A: Yes. Ceramic coating requires a paint correction service before it's installed.
